summary: Python CLI terminal verifier for PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; requires --repository-root and --plan-dir, accepts optional --out; resolves root/plan though plan is otherwise unused; checks W0-W6 under logs/tdd-adapter/toolchain-workflow-repair/<slice>/ for exactly one */slice-receipt.json; failures: current-pass-receipt-required, receipt-invalid, receipt-not-current-pass; valid receipt requires predicate=slice-ready, status=pass, failures=[], authorizes=[]; emits schema toolchain-workflow-repair.terminal-result.v2 with predicate implementation-complete, pass only with no failures, authorizes=[], lifecycle_transition=none; sorted indented JSON to stdout and optional output file; exit 0 on pass, 1 on fail; digest helper is unused.
